estimand.reference: all permitted positive pilot and collection-window history from one fixed eligible cohort
estimand.sample: same cohort with a local chronological history cap or item-tail reserve cap
estimand.claim_boundary: offline MovieLens replay; no device availability, dropout, secure aggregation, consent, bytes, rounds, or federated convergence claim

cohort.selection: deterministic lowest keyed hash among users with the pilot minimum and a positive interaction in the final 365 pilot days

policies.equal_chronological_cap: retain each client's first k positive collection-window events
policies.tail_reserve_cap: retain up to k events per client; reserve half of capacity for the client's earliest collection events whose item has pilot popularity at or below the pilot 20th-percentile count, then fill by chronological order

evaluation.candidate_catalog: all rating-bearing items in the pinned snapshot
evaluation.fixed_exclusion: all pilot and collection-window items seen by each cohort client, independent of policy

metric_notes.ndcg_at_10: normalized by min(K, |relevant|); not capped by relevant-set size
metric_notes.recall_at_10: hits / |relevant|; structurally capped at K/|relevant| for heavy users

item_item.model: deterministic item-item cosine over positive interactions
item_item.support_scope: fixed full-reference item counts, identical for every policy
item_item.role: primary personalized probe; no random state

als.model: implicit alternating least squares over positive interactions
als.aggregation: per-user mean across seeds; identical seed set for every condition
als.tuning: fixed a priori; no search against the future-test window
